required_primitives.purpose: Expose running, paused or reduced-motion state without technical implementation text.
Keep the current observable value inside the experiment stage.
Map visual marks to model objects without adding a course panel.
Provide one labelled primary parameter with value and unit.
Echo the parameter value next to the control.
Pause or continue the observable process.
Return the experiment to one declared initial state.
Use a native details disclosure for narrow screens.

motion_policy: Continuous animation stops in reduced-motion; direct parameter input still renders a static result.
content_policy: Keep only model labels, observable values and one short status sentence; course goals and long explanations stay outside the experiment.
